title: Prepaid hours on contracts: priced block in advance, overage in arrears (alga-2026-0002684)

marks.label: 1. The contract: service desk fee + one Prepaid Block line (Billing > Contracts > EQUIT Prepaid Hours Acceptance R2 > Contract Lines)
2. Block hours, price, issue mode and rollover are configured in one place (Prepaid Block > Edit)
3. First invoice INV-000163 = $3,000: fixed fee + 10 h block, both billed in advance (Billing > Invoicing > Finalized)
4. Next invoice INV-000164 = $3,600: next block in advance + 4 overage hours x $150 in arrears
5. Simulator on the saved contract: 14 assumed hours gives $3,000 then $3,600, no manual edits (Client Contracts > R2 > Simulate)
6. Compare with past invoices (Sep-Oct 2026): every simulated line matches INV-000163 / INV-000164 at +$0.00

7. After a client switches to quarterly billing, Compare with past invoices still replays the billed monthly windows: Sep $1,500 = INV-000168, Oct $2,100 = INV-000170 (Client Contracts > EQUIT Block Hours R5 > Simulate)
8. Due Work: the Nov group combines Oct overage (arrears) with the Nov block and fixed fee (advance) (Billing > Invoicing > Generate, Invoice window to 11/30/2026)
9. Preview: $1,500 fee + $1,500 Nov block + 3 Oct overage hours x $150 = $3,450
10. Generate the invoice from the preview; the group leaves Due Work
11. Draft INV-000172 = $3,450: block fee, overage and $0 draw line, each with its own period (Billing > Invoicing > Drafts)
12. Remaining hours with dollar value: client Hour Blocks (Clients > EQUIT Acceptance 2684 R2 > Billing Dashboard)
13. Contract Reports: used, remaining, remaining value, valid from and expiry per block (Billing > Reports > Bucket Hours)
14. Templates carry the same priced block (Billing > Contract Templates > EQUIT Block Hours Template R2)
Failure & recovery A: invoice generated too early. Reverse Draft voids the Nov block and releases the overage hours (Drafts > INV-000172 > Reverse Draft)
Recovery: the Nov group is back in Due Work, ready to generate again
Failure B: a zero-hour block is refused with a clear message; Cancel leaves the saved block unchanged (Contract Lines > Prepaid Block > Edit)
15. Client portal: the client sees prepaid hours left with their dollar value (Client Portal > Billing; signed in as tinus.smoke2684@equit.example)
